title: Odoo to go
summary: A mobile interface for browsing and editing Odoo records through XML-RPC.
content:
I explored a mobile interface for Odoo Community and Enterprise, using XML-RPC to load modules and their records from an Odoo server.

Working with business data

The app presents records in lists, supports searching within modules, editing record contents and deleting individual entries. It also loads module submenus.

An iOS widget provides a shortcut for creating contacts. A Kanban view was still in development in the earlier project documentation and is not presented here as a completed feature.
